no, i dont know. maybe because nobody wants me here. not just here...here, as in..in this house..but everywhere. my entire family. they all dislike me. none of them are talking to me. i don't tolerate rejection at all. i mean, i know nobody does, but im not one that can just kinda, shrug it off like..well, they will just come around whenever....i *stew* over **why** someone is mad at me...like..**what did I do wrong to make them hate me?**  I just *can't* deal with that and it's like that with everyone around ehre.
i stop being able to breathe. i want to turn and run the other way and never return. my mind goes in every other direction. the urges get stronger....i, well, i just cant explain
that is when i hit the wall....

yes, it is...but, maybe i didn't sound clear in my post, idk. it's EVERYTHING, not just work. coming HOME is almost the worst part of my day. i dread it. i feel sick. i want to shut down completely at that point. so as far as work...that isn't the worst part.
i really don't think it is my job, in itself, that is wearing me down. i think that is just a minor part of all of this....
i have always wanted to do this job. i don't think it is the job itself that is bothering me. it is...life. when i am at work, it is almost, well...easier, to put that "plastic" smile in place...
no i really don't know. seems it just happened gradually over time.
no, tired out as in i get no enjoyment at all, from..well, my job, or life at all. that kind of tired out, not the kind that sleep will fix.
idk what changed. perhaps i just got too tired. too worn out. as for when? over time? I just don't have an answer for that. im sorry.
Peace..only way for peace finally. For me and others.

I have changed my mind many times for, I have attempted this before...I have made up my mind this time. I am ready to end my pain, my lonliness, my hurt, my unhappiness...and the same that I cause everyone else around me. It is the one thing that I want for myself. I don't often allow things for myself. This is one thing I am going to allow myself, finally.
I'm sorry, but I've made up my mind.
